messages.subject: Filter minor alleles in version 1.0.5?
parts:
Hi there, 

I am using dartR version 1.0.5 because I am using a github script that was written for this version (in case it is important, the github install_github('jdyen/dartR@sexlinkage', dependencies = FALSE, force = TRUE) ). 

I have some questions, and hopefully a solution (?) but just want to double check. 

1. I would like to filter out minor alleles in a gl created in version 1.0.5. As far as I can see, I can identify minor allele frequency using gl.report.maf(). Is there a way that I can identify them and filter them out?

2. gl.filter.minoralleles() function, in v1.9.9.1, does not work for my genlight object that I created in 1.0.5. It gives me the following error 
Error in if (x@other$loc.metrics.flags$monomorphs == FALSE) { : 
  argument is of length zero

3. In the error above, gl.filter.minoralleles() from version 1.9.9.1 appears to be looking for monomorphs (i.e. $monomorphs). In which case, can I use gl.filter.monomorphs() from 1.0.5? Are these two functions doing the same thing?

Many thanks!
Lana
